chunk_map.heading: A solution can wear an opportunity's clothes

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4: "It is already a choice" — 'It' resolves to the quoted "I want to go out to eat" in the preceding sentence; L6 "In her tree" resolves to Teresa Torres named in L4 of the same chunk. Harm (unresolved referent) absent.

rules_evaluated.na_reason: no pointer to another file or deck position

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no 'the X you did/saw' backward beat reference

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: L4-8: single chunk carries a full claim (solution disguised as opportunity, tree structure, agent cost vs listening); closest to thin is L8 "With agents, three rough solutions cost an afternoon…" which still lands a claim.
Header L1 "A solution can wear an opportunity's clothes" is the claim of L4 ("a solution wearing an opportunity's clothes"); L6-8 extend it with tree structure and cost, none contradict it.

Closest: L4 two short sentences "It is already a choice." — a single declarative, not 'Not X. Not Y. Z.'; no anaphora triple, no superlative, no number-retraction ("three rough solutions" L8 is a labelled framing per maintainer guard), no verb triplet, no abstraction stack.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No repo vocabulary on the body (surface/firing/compendium/beat/mood) in L1-8; 'opportunity tree', 'outcome', 'solutions' are Torres's practitioner terms and what a product trio calls them.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No bold in body L1-8 (grep '\*\*' on body region → 0); within budget of ≤1.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: slide file included via manifest; presence governed by the include, not by this body

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: check-slide-numbering.js --file → 'OK — 1 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent', exit 0; header carries no hand-numbering.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: check-slide-deixis.js --file → 'OK — 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut', exit 0; body L4-8 has no above/below/see below.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L1 header is a claim ("A solution can wear an opportunity's clothes"), the lecture-style grammar the rule wants.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L8 "Knowing which opportunity matters still takes listening to customers." — adds the human-limit counterweight to the agent-cost claim, not a restatement of the header or a koan.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no header rename evidenced; maintainer STATUS records a fresh build, not a retitle over inherited bullets

notes: Single-chunk slide file; accept-notes: none authorising a rule exception (L12 STATUS and L26 source stamp are dated lines only). Body is slide-file; no includes.
